list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this guide was written. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and names its sources beside it; no guide text is copied from another guide.
sources_note: List sources: Exophase (GTA VI trophy list) and PSNProfiles (GTA VI trophy list), which agree on every name, description and grade. Method sources named per trophy: GTA Wiki, IGN GTA 6 Wiki and PowerPyx trophy guides — check the cited source for exact launch-day locations, since the game released 19 November 2026 and the community is still mapping spots.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one needs no separate effort: it pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Follow this guide's roadmap in order and it will be the final unlock. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missable_reason: Story mission — complete it during the story flow.
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission 'Gone Fishing' from start to finish. It is the game's first mission, so follow the objectives as they appear and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missable_reason: Chapter trophy — finish every Chapter 1 mission.
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1. The chapter closes when its last mission is finished, so work through the story in order and this will pop at the chapter's end. Stranger strands that open during Chapter 1 are worth clearing before you move on. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missable_reason: Chapter trophy — finish every Chapter 2 mission.
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 2 until the chapter closes. Like Chapter 1, just follow the story missions in order. The name appears here exactly as PlayStation prints it, asterisks and all. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missable_reason: Chapter trophy — finish every Chapter 3 mission.
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 3 until the chapter closes. New activities and stranger strands keep opening as you go — try each activity type once along the way, since that counts toward Master of None. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missable_reason: Chapter trophy — finish every Chapter 4 mission.
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 4 until the chapter closes. Before the finale, clear any stranger strands and side missions still open — endgame clean-up is much faster once the story is fully done. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI story chapters

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_reason: Final story mission — the story's last beat.
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission, which unlocks after Chapter 4. The trophy pops with the credits once it is done. Anything you still need — collectibles, activities — stays available in free roam afterwards, so the finale is not a point of no return. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI final mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Breakfast Run' when it shows up in the story. Play it to the end and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Breakfast Run mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'The Cartel Heist' when it shows up. Heist missions usually start with a setup phase — complete the setups, then the heist itself, and this pops. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — The Cartel Heist mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — The Cartel Heist mission

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Child's Play' when it shows up. Follow its objectives to the end and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Child's Play mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Headliners' when it shows up. Play it through to the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Headliners mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'VCIA Takedown' when it shows up. It is the airport takedown — expect a vehicle-heavy set piece — and finish it to earn this. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — VCIA Takedown mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission — complete it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory' when it shows up. Play it through to the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Operation Savage Glory mission.
sources: GTA Wiki — Operation Savage Glory mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Get to 100% completion. In GTA games that means the story, all stranger and side missions, every activity, every collectible and all the counted side content — the in-game stats screen shows which categories are still short. It is usually the last gold before the platinum: finish everything else first, then use the stats screen to chase the last few percent. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — 100% Completion in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — 100% Completion in GTA VI

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: jumps, near-misses, drifts, airtime and other stunt driving, all counted as you play. The total grows naturally through the story and free roam, so drive fast and take risks between objectives; if you are short at the end, chain stunt jumps and long drifts on open highways and airport runways until the counter hits 250. The stats screen tracks it. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Stunts in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Stunts in GTA VI

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Take part in each of the 9 activity types at least once: shooting range, fishing, racing, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities the game lists. Winning or finishing is not required — just start and play each type once. Do it early, while the story carries you past the activity spots, so none is left for a separate trip. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; IGN — GTA 6 Wiki (activities).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the ranges across Leonida and work through every weapon challenge, aiming for the gold score the range shows you. Use the range's own scoring feedback — gold needs accuracy and speed, so learn one challenge's target pattern before rushing the next. Expect several sessions, not one sitting. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (Shooting Range).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Every location runs its own race — fly the course, beat the target time or the rival, then move to the next spot. Drone races reward a steady line more than raw speed: learn the gates on a first run, then push for the win on the next. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; IGN — GTA 6 Wiki (Top Fun drone races).
sources: IGN — GTA 6 Wiki (Top Fun drone races)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats do not count, each win must be a new race. Race around Leonida in cars, bikes and boats as each event allows, and pick the faster vehicle class for each event. Work through the race list in order and tick each win off in this guide so you never re-run one you already won. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Races in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Races in GTA VI

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots and accept his challenge — fishing is a timing game, so watch the line tension and reel in steady bursts instead of holding the button down. Win once and this pops. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; IGN — GTA 6 Wiki (fishing).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Walk up to a cabinet, start a game and play it through to the end — any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you like. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Arcade games in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Arcade games in GTA VI

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Andy's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger missions appear as question-mark encounters across Leonida — find Andy, play every mission in his strand in order, and the finale pops this trophy. Do strands as they open rather than saving them all for the endgame. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Andy).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Andy)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Kenton's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Find Kenton, play his strand mission by mission, and complete the finale. Stranger strands are easy to walk past, so check the map for the stranger icon whenever you reach a new area. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Kenton).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Kenton)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Billy's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Track Billy down, work through his missions in order and complete the finale. If a strand seems to stall, check whether its next mission only unlocks after a story chapter or another strand's mission. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Billy).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Billy)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Work through 8 complete stranger strands across Leonida. A strand is a chain of missions tied to one stranger — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone make five, so you need three more strangers whose chains you also finish. Strangers appear as icons on the map; look for them in each region between story chapters and wrap up each strand before you move on. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Randy's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends in a finale mission of its own: find him, work through his missions in turn, and complete the last one. Stranger icons on the map mark where his next mission waits. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Randy).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Randy)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strand finale — finish Tyrone's whole strand before the story ends.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends in a finale mission of its own: find him, work through his missions in turn, and complete the last one. Stranger icons on the map mark where his next mission waits. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Tyrone).
sources: GTA Wiki — Strangers in GTA VI (Tyrone)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are scenic viewpoints — walk to one, use the meditate prompt and let the session finish, then move on to the next. They are spread across the whole state, so work through them region by region and tick them off as you go; the GTA Wiki's meditation-spot map is the fastest way to find any you are missing. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Meditation spots in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Meditation spots in GTA VI

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret and take his hunting work, then track the unique animal he names — use the hunting clues and your weapon of choice, and bring the hunt to a clean end. Unique animals are one of a kind, so follow Bret's guidance rather than hunting at random. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Hunting in GTA VI (Bret).
sources: GTA Wiki — Hunting in GTA VI (Bret)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish 3 complete collectible card sets. Cards turn up all over Leonida — in shops, inside buildings and out in the open — and a set is only done when every card in it is found. Grab cards whenever you see them, check the collection screen for sets that are nearly done, then use the GTA Wiki's card maps to track down the stragglers. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Collectible Cards in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Collectible Cards in GTA VI

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Log a WAiNK It check-in at 100 separate locations. WAiNK is the game's photo/check-in activity — open it at viewpoints, landmarks and scenic spots around Leonida to record the place. Only new locations count, so repeats are wasted: sweep the map area by area, and use the GTA Wiki's WAiNK list to chase the last few. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — WAiNK in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — WAiNK in GTA VI

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small tracked feats — driving, combat, exploration and activity goals that tick off as you play. They build up across everything you do, so just play broadly and check the challenges menu often; near the end, pick off the easiest unfinished ones (short drives, simple combat feats) to reach 50. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Challenges in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Challenges in GTA VI

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you at 4 stars — do it during a partner story moment.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Cause enough chaos near police to reach 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight, hide until the stars blink, and stay out of the search area until you are clear — with your partner still with you. Easiest during a story stretch where your partner is already riding along. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Wanted level in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Wanted level in GTA VI

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you — do it during a partner story moment.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the wanted level must stay alive across all three robberies, back to back. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving between them so the stars never drop to zero. If they clear, the chain breaks and you start over. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Robberies in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Robberies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Get into 100 different vehicles for the first time. A first drive in a new model counts as a discovery, so try everything — cars, bikes, trucks, boats, aircraft — and look at the in-game vehicle list to spot types you have never driven. New models in traffic count; the tenth ride in the same sedan does not. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Vehicles in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Vehicles in GTA VI

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time while you aim — start it in a heavy firefight with at least five enemies visible and take them down one by one before it runs out. Choose a mission or shootout where enemies cluster together, and bring a fast, accurate weapon so all five fall in that one use. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Combat Focus in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Combat Focus in GTA VI

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_reason: A one-off airport stunt — best done while the VCIA mission puts you there.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in a plane without clearance — an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport. Get hold of a plane on the airport runways and take off on your own terms. The VCIA Takedown mission brings you to the airport anyway, so attempt it while you are already there. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — VCIA in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — VCIA in GTA VI

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank — the description gives the joke away ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos'). Drive it around and fire the cannon until the trophy unlocks. Rhinos show up at high wanted levels and at military sites, so either stir up a heavy police response or find one parked at a base, then take it for a spin. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Rhino tank in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Rhino tank in GTA VI

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_reason: A clean stealth robbery — one failed attempt can mean a loud, detected run instead.
trophies.guide: Pull off a jewelry store robbery without anyone noticing. Slip in quietly: keep moving slowly, stay out of sight lines, dodge the cameras and guards, take the goods and get out before the alarm goes up. If someone spots you, walk away and come back another time — a robbery that gets detected does not count. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Robberies in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Robberies in GTA VI

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Hit 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vault jobs are a step up from shop robberies — crack the vault, grab the cash and clear out before the police lock the area down. Work out your getaway before you go in, and leave a fast car close by. Five vaults, five clean getaways. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Bank robberies in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Bank robberies in GTA VI

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hold up an armored truck and get away. The trucks follow fixed routes around Leonida — spot one on the road, force it to stop by ramming or blocking it, break it open, grab the cash and shake the police. Hit it somewhere with a clear escape route. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Armored trucks in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Armored trucks in GTA VI

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The map keeps track of where you have been — drive, fly or sail through every named district and region until nothing is left grey. Go area by area (Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, the northern towns) and look for unvisited patches on the map. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Leonida map in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Leonida map in GTA VI

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs hidden rackets — drug labs, stash houses, smuggling spots — scattered around Leonida. Find one operation in each gang's turf, rob it, then move on to the next gang. The GTA Wiki's gang-operation map shows all nine at a glance. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Gangs and illegal operations in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Gangs and illegal operations in GTA VI

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach looking out to sea, order a cocktail and soak in the view — the trophy triggers once the moment lands. An easy, quiet one to grab while you are wandering Vice Beach. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Ocean Beach in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Ocean Beach in GTA VI

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_reason: A one-off showroom stunt — do it the first time you are inside a showroom with a car.
trophies.guide: Burst out of a vehicle showroom through the glass, classic GTA style — drive a car straight at the showroom's big front window. Bring a car inside (or use one already there), line up the window and put your foot down. It is the famous showroom escape, so grab the moment the first time you are in a showroom with a car rather than putting it off. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Vehicle showrooms in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Vehicle showrooms in GTA VI

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley. Find the alley, grab a ball and play a game right through to the end — the follow-through is the bowling itself, so finishing the game is what earns this. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Bowling in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Bowling in GTA VI

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Share a moment with your partner that gets the public's attention. It is a partner moment tied to the story: keep doing partner missions and shared activities, and it triggers when the two of you pull off something the crowd loves. If the story ends without it, run the partner activities again in free roam. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Partner activities in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Partner activities in GTA VI

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Built on choices you make as you play — make choices instead of avoiding them.
trophies.guide: Keep making choices — PlayStation counts them up to 500. The game keeps offering decisions (what you say, how you tackle a mission, the moral calls): keep picking an option instead of always taking the same road, and the tally rises. It builds slowly over the whole game, so choose something whenever the chance comes up. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Choices in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Choices in GTA VI

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_reason: A second attempt after a failure — fail once, then succeed.
trophies.guide: Fail once, then win on the very next try. The game is watching for the comeback — an attempt that fails followed at once by a success. When a mission or activity goes wrong, retry it straight away instead of drifting off; it is that immediate second-attempt win that counts. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophy guides.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophy guides

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Run into something strange — a UFO-style oddity or an event nobody can explain, somewhere in Leonida. GTA always hides one weird encounter like this; poke around the far corners of the map after dark (the swamps, the Keys, the desert roads) and it will find you. The GTA Wiki's easter-egg pages list where players have spotted it since launch. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Easter eggs in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Easter eggs in GTA VI

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Flatten someone with a melee drive-by — clip a pedestrian with a melee weapon as you drive past. Carry a melee weapon (a bat does the job), cruise slowly past someone on foot and swing as you go by. Pick a quiet street so you can time it right, and mind the wanted level that follows. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Melee drive-bys in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Melee drive-bys in GTA VI

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Wash $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — hand them to your laundering contacts and turn them into clean cash, a bit at a time, until the total reaches $250,000. Keep robbing banks, vaults and armored trucks so the Bills keep coming, and launder little and often so the total keeps climbing. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Marked Bills in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Marked Bills in GTA VI

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in the shops — clothes, weapons, car mods, food and the rest all feed the one total. Buy what you need as you go and the counter rises on its own; if you are short near the end, put the rest into weapon upgrades and vehicle mods, the most expensive single buys. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Shops in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Shops in GTA VI

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Own all 8 garage properties. Garages are properties you can buy, marked on the map — save up, buy one whenever you can afford it, and check the property list for the ones you still lack. They also give you somewhere to park the vehicles you find for Whip It Good, so buy them as you go. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Properties in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Properties in GTA VI

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Put 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app. Track down ten different vehicles, open Scooter Bros on your in-game phone and register each one — any type the app takes will do. Pair it with Whip It Good and register cars as you discover them, so both trophies move together. Source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; GTA Wiki — Scooter Bros app in GTA VI.
sources: GTA Wiki — Scooter Bros app in GTA VI

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4
roadmap.text: Play the story in order and finish every chapter and named mission. Along the way, try each activity type once (Master of None), keep your partner beside you for Hot Together and Retail Therapy, and pick up stranger strands as they open. Do not rush past the partner moments — they are the missable ones.

roadmap.title: Strangers & side stories
roadmap.text: Finish all 8 stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more) and Bret's hunt. Strands unlock across the story, so sweep the map for stranger icons between chapters and finish each strand before the finale.

roadmap.title: Collectibles sweep
roadmap.text: Meditate at all 18 spots, complete 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, explore all 52 areas, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles to Scooter Bros. Work region by region with the GTA Wiki location maps for the last few of each.

roadmap.title: Activities, skills & money
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win 20 races and 14 drone races, pull off 250 stunts, finish 50 challenges, rob 5 bank vaults and one operation per gang, launder $250,000 of Marked Bills and spend $100,000 in shops. This is the long grind — spread it across the whole playthrough, not one sitting.

roadmap.title: Clean-up & platinum
roadmap.text: Check the in-game stats screen for the last few percent of 100% completion, mop up anything left, and the gold for 100% pops — then the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops with it.

missable_summary: 24 trophies are flagged missable in this guide: the 12 chapter and named story missions, the 5 stranger-strand finales, the two partner-moment trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), the one-off stunts (Catch Me If You Can, Capital Offense), the stealth robbery (Sneakthief), the choices trophy (Actions Speak Louder) and the second-attempt trophy (Bad Luck, I Guess). Every other trophy can be earned in free roam after the story ends.
